steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: In SALVA, both the doctors and patients in this hospital believe Mania will be cured one day.

For a moment, you regret opening the hidden door. It was originally locked from the inside. The SALVA doctors blocked the way out with their last sanity to cut off the madness from the rest of the place.
The patients who came for refuge and the doctors who came down to help—All of them left this world in the most tragic way.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We found Ted. He's with Anne and that assassin. Get up, Chief. Don't forget your target.
The nightmare smashes a wall. In the midst of the cloud of dust, you hear a familiar and repulsive sound.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: How persistent, Chief. But what a shame. You're too late.
Anne collapses on the contaminated floor in her blood-soaked white robe.
